name: Cold Soba Noodle, Edamame & Veggie Salad with Curried Coconut Dressing

instructions.primary_message: Fill a large pot about halfway with hot water (from the tap); add salt, cover with a lid, and bring to a boil over high heat.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 limes
1 ½ red bell peppers
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 small bunch cilantro

instructions.primary_message: Zest and juice limes into a small bowl. Add coconut milk, sugar, curry powder, and salt; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (398 ml) cans coconut milk
3 tbsp brown sugar
1 tbsp curry powder
1 ½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Once the water in the pot is boiling, add the noodles and edamame; cook noodles according to package directions, about 5 minutes. Once done, drain and rinse thoroughly under cold water.
Meanwhile, trim, seed, and halve bell peppers crosswise, then slice into thin strips. Place in a large bowl.
Trim and halve cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Add to the bowl with the bell pepper.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl.
Add noodles, edamame, cabbage, and carrots to the bowl; toss to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ (397 g) bags shredded cabbage (coleslaw mix)
1 ½ (283 g) bags shredded carrots

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide salad between plates or bowls; drizzle with dressing and enjoy. Enjoy!
